text:
**Verdict: fix.** The work needs changes before it should merge. The review is at `public/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/25/session-e06424f1/task-mastermind/review.md`.

The diff adds an opt-in "tail mode": the smart voice seat follows its own `session.jsonl` and skips its own lines with a new `skip_by` filter.

**Must change:**
1. **Unwanted wakes.** The filter only drops lines by their author, but most lines the server writes have no author field. On every batch, `feed_smart()` still writes a `{sent}` line before it returns, and Follow then delivers that line as a paid Opus turn of its own. Other housekeeping lines (`refined`, `skip`, `quiet` and so on) get through the same way. The filter should list the lines that may wake the seat, the way `worth_waking` does for a parent following its child.
2. **The task folder can't be picked up.** It has no `requirements.md`, plan or landing line. The ask and what's left are written only in `ux/Dictate/doc/wake-policy.md`.
3. **Not merged.** The two commits sit on `worktree/qf-8`, but the doc already says "Built".

**Notes:**
- **Smaller than the ask.** The owner asked for one mechanism in place of the wake policy. This adds a switch next to the policy, off by default. The doc says so honestly, and it had promised a plan before building, which was never written.
- **`{place}` lines.** `skip_by` drops the fast seat's `{place}` lines, but the doc's own plan says the smart seat should get them.
- **Stale comment.** `settings()`'s comment doesn't mention `tail`.
- **Gather window.** `tail_ms` is read but no route sets it.
- **No switch.** The dictation widget has no switch for tail mode.

**Tests:** both pass on the worktree: `Follow-skip.test.mjs` prints "ok" and `WakePolicy.test.mjs` passes 17 checks. The new check uses a fake `follow`, so it doesn't catch the unwanted wakes in finding 1.

The worktree has no `node_modules`, so I ran the tests on a throwaway copy of its files, placed under `Servex/node_modules` so the packages resolve. I deleted the copy afterwards. I made no code edits.

I rewrote `requirements.md` and logged it to `flags.jsonl` as `rewrote`.

The ask list had no ticks and put the proof in a separate "Done" section, so I merged the two. The four asks are now a checklist, each with its proof beside it. Asks 3 and 4 are ticked. Asks 1 and 2 are unticked because tail mode isn't proven in a live call and the `{place}` lines in the Prompt record shape aren't written yet. "Left" became "Next", also as a checklist.

`text-check` flagged nothing in `requirements.md`. It did flag `review.md` (568 words, three paragraphs over 60 words, no picture) and `past-work.md` (753 words). I left both alone because the target was only `requirements.md`.

I didn't look at the page in a screenshot, since this proposal has no `page.js`.
